rationale: Control DPR-C05 explicitly mandates processing personal data only for the purpose for which consent was given or for legitimate uses permitted by law.

obligation_span.quote: A Data Fiduciary shall process personal data only for a lawful purpose for which the Data Principal has given consent or for certain legitimate uses

control_span.quote: Personal data shall be processed only for the purpose for which consent was given or for legitimate uses permitted by law

rationale: Control DPR-C03 fully matches the obligation, stating that every request for consent shall be accompanied or preceded by a notice describing the personal data and purpose of processing.

obligation_span.quote: Every request for consent shall be accompanied or preceded by a notice describing the personal data and the purpose of processing

control_span.quote: Every request for consent shall be accompanied or preceded by a notice describing the personal data to be processed and the purpose of processing

rationale: Control DPR-C03 fully addresses the requirement by specifying that the notice is available in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution, at the customer's option.

obligation_span.quote: The Data Fiduciary shall give the Data Principal the option to access the notice in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution

control_span.quote: available in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution, at the customer's option

rationale: The control directly addresses protecting personal data using reasonable security safeguards like encryption, masking, and access control to prevent breaches.

obligation_span.quote: protect personal data by taking reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breach

control_span.quote: implement reasonable security safeguards, including encryption, masking and access control, to prevent personal data breach

rationale: The control specifies encryption standards for data at rest and in transit, which addresses security safeguards, but does not cover other aspects like masking or access controls mentioned in typical security safeguards.

obligation_span.quote: protect personal data by taking reasonable security safeguards

control_span.quote: Data at rest shall be encrypted using AES-256 or stronger and data in transit shall be protected using TLS 1.2 or higher

rationale: DPR-C09 covers erasure of personal data upon account closure within 180 days, but lacks general erasure when purposes are no longer served or consent is withdrawn for all contexts.

obligation_span.quote: A Data Fiduciary shall erase personal data when the purpose is no longer being served or consent is withdrawn, unless retention is necessary for compliance with any law

control_span.quote: Personal data of customers whose accounts have been closed, including KYC documents, shall be erased from all systems within 180 days of account closure

missing_elements: Erased when purpose no longer served or consent withdrawn

rationale: DPR-C01 requires designating a Data Protection Officer and publishing their business contact details on the website and mobile app.

obligation_span.quote: A Data Fiduciary shall publish the business contact information of a person who is able to answer questions of the Data Principal about the processing of personal data

control_span.quote: The Bank shall designate a Data Protection Officer based in India who shall be the point of contact for grievance redressal, and shall publish the business contact details of the Data Protection Officer on its website and mobile application

rationale: DPR-C06 perfectly mirrors the requirement to obtain verifiable consent of the parent or lawful guardian before processing a child's personal data.

obligation_span.quote: Before processing personal data of a child, a Data Fiduciary shall obtain verifiable consent of the parent or lawful guardian

control_span.quote: Before processing personal data of a child, the Bank shall obtain verifiable consent of the parent or lawful guardian and shall not undertake tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children

rationale: The control explicitly prohibits tracking, behavioural monitoring, or targeted advertising directed at children, fully meeting the obligation.

obligation_span.quote: A Data Fiduciary shall not undertake tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children

control_span.quote: shall not undertake tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children

rationale: The control requires designating a Data Protection Officer based in India, fully satisfying the obligation.

obligation_span.quote: A Significant Data Fiduciary shall appoint a Data Protection Officer based in India

control_span.quote: The Bank shall designate a Data Protection Officer based in India

rationale: The control mandates conducting an annual Data Protection Impact Assessment and an independent data audit, fully meeting the requirement.

obligation_span.quote: A Significant Data Fiduciary shall undertake a periodic Data Protection Impact Assessment and an independent data audit

control_span.quote: The Bank shall conduct an annual Data Protection Impact Assessment and an independent data audit

rationale: The control explicitly mandates an annual Data Protection Impact Assessment and an independent data audit, matching the obligation.

obligation_span.quote: undertake a periodic Data Protection Impact Assessment and an independent data audit

control_span.quote: The Bank shall conduct an annual Data Protection Impact Assessment and an independent data audit

rationale: The control ensures that requests from Data Principals for access to their personal data are handled upon request.

obligation_span.quote: on request, provide the Data Principal with information about the personal data processed and the processing activities

control_span.quote: Requests from Data Principals for access to, correction, completion or updating of their personal data shall be resolved within 30 days of receipt

rationale: The control covers correction, completion, and updating of personal data on request, but omits erasure.

obligation_span.quote: give effect to a request of the Data Principal for correction, completion, updating and erasure of personal data

control_span.quote: Requests from Data Principals for access to, correction, completion or updating of their personal data shall be resolved within 30 days of receipt

rationale: Control ITO-C01 explicitly requires the Board to approve the IT outsourcing policy.

obligation_span.quote: Every RE shall put in place a Board approved policy on IT outsourcing

control_span.quote: The Board shall approve this Policy

rationale: Control ITO-C01 explicitly states that the IT Strategy Committee shall oversee all IT outsourcing arrangements.

obligation_span.quote: The IT Strategy Committee of the RE shall exercise oversight of all IT outsourcing arrangements

control_span.quote: the IT Strategy Committee shall oversee all IT outsourcing arrangements

rationale: Control ITO-C02 mandates assessing each IT outsourcing arrangement for materiality before onboarding.

obligation_span.quote: The RE shall assess the materiality of each outsourcing arrangement before entering into it

control_span.quote: Each IT outsourcing arrangement shall be assessed for materiality before onboarding

rationale: Control ITO-C02 mandates that all IT outsourcing arrangements shall be recorded in the Outsourcing Register, fulfilling the requirement to maintain an inventory.

obligation_span.quote: The RE shall maintain an inventory of all outsourced IT services

control_span.quote: all arrangements shall be recorded in the Outsourcing Register with their materiality classification

rationale: Control ITO-C03 explicitly requires conducting due diligence on the service provider before entering into an arrangement.

obligation_span.quote: The RE shall carry out due diligence of the service provider before outsourcing

control_span.quote: Before entering into an arrangement, the Bank shall conduct due diligence on the service provider covering financial soundness, technical capability, reputation and information security posture

rationale: Control ITO-C04 ensures that outsourcing agreements provide access and audit rights to the Bank and the Reserve Bank of India.

obligation_span.quote: The RE shall ensure that the agreement provides access and audit rights to the regulated entity and to the RBI

control_span.quote: Every outsourcing agreement shall provide for the right of the Bank and the Reserve Bank of India, or persons authorised by them, to access and audit the service provider

rationale: The control explicitly mandates that every outsourcing agreement includes clauses on confidentiality, sub-contracting, and termination.

obligation_span.quote: The RE shall ensure that the agreement covers confidentiality, sub-contracting and termination

control_span.quote: Every outsourcing agreement shall provide for the right of the Bank and the Reserve Bank of India, or persons authorised by them, to access and audit the service provider, together with clauses on confidentiality, sub-contracting and termination

rationale: The control covers risk assessment and performance monitoring for material service providers at least annually.

obligation_span.quote: The RE shall undertake periodic risk assessment and performance monitoring of service providers

control_span.quote: Material service providers shall be subjected to a risk assessment at least annually, and the results shall be reported to the IT Strategy Committee

rationale: The control specifically establishes quarterly reviews and controls over privileged access granted to service-provider personnel on Bank systems.

obligation_span.quote: The RE shall put in place controls over service provider access to regulated entity systems and data

control_span.quote: Privileged access granted to service-provider personnel on Bank systems shall be reviewed every quarter, and access that is no longer required shall be revoked

rationale: ITO-C07 specifically requires monitoring and reporting concentration risk arising from reliance on service providers.

obligation_span.quote: The RE shall monitor the concentration risk of service providers

control_span.quote: Concentration risk arising from reliance on a single service provider shall be monitored and reported to the IT Strategy Committee every six months

rationale: ITO-C08 explicitly requires maintaining a Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plan with the service provider and conducting joint drills.

obligation_span.quote: The RE shall ensure that a business continuity and disaster recovery plan with the service provider is in place and periodically tested

control_span.quote: For each material outsourcing arrangement, the Bank shall maintain a Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plan with the service provider and conduct a joint disaster recovery drill at least annually

rationale: ITO-C09 mandates maintaining a documented exit strategy including transition arrangements for outsourcing arrangements.

obligation_span.quote: The RE shall have an exit strategy for outsourcing arrangements

control_span.quote: A documented exit strategy, including transition arrangements, shall be maintained for every material outsourcing arrangement

rationale: The control directly ensures the KYC policy is approved by the Board of Directors.

obligation_span.quote: Every RE shall have a KYC policy duly approved by its Board of Directors

control_span.quote: This Policy shall be approved by the Board of Directors

rationale: The control covers the nomination of both a Designated Director and a Principal Officer and communicating their details to FIU-IND.

obligation_span.quote: Every RE shall nominate a Designated Director and a Principal Officer and communicate their names and contact details to FIU-IND

control_span.quote: The Bank shall nominate a Designated Director and a Principal Officer and communicate their names, designation and contact details to FIU-IND

rationale: The control mandates communicating the names and contact details of the Designated Director and Principal Officer to FIU-IND.

obligation_span.quote: communicate their names and contact details to FIU-IND

control_span.quote: communicate their names, designation and contact details to FIU-IND

rationale: The control explicitly prohibits anonymous or fictitious accounts and mandates verification of OVD before activation.

obligation_span.quote: 5. No RE shall open an account in an anonymous or fictitious or benami name

control_span.quote: No account shall be opened in an anonymous or fictitious name. The Core Banking System shall block account activation unless the customer's OVD has been verified

rationale: The control directly mandates identity and address verification using an OVD or Aadhaar-based e-KYC authentication at onboarding.

obligation_span.quote: Every RE shall undertake customer due diligence using an Officially Valid Document or Aadhaar e-KYC authentication

control_span.quote: At onboarding, the identity and address of every individual customer shall be verified using an OVD or Aadhaar-based e-KYC authentication, and the outcome shall be recorded in the onboarding system

rationale: The control explicitly requires identifying beneficial owners for legal entity customers and taking reasonable measures to verify their identity.

obligation_span.quote: Where the customer is a legal entity, the RE shall identify the beneficial owner and take reasonable measures to verify the identity of the beneficial owner

control_span.quote: For customers that are legal entities, the Bank shall identify the beneficial owner(s) as per the thresholds prescribed under the PML Rules and take reasonable measures to verify their identity

rationale: Control KYC-C07 explicitly requires screening the customer's name against the UNSC sanctions lists and UAPA lists before account activation, matching the requirement before opening an account.

obligation_span.quote: Before opening an account, the RE shall verify that the customer does not appear in the UNSC sanctions lists or the lists of individuals and entities designated under the UAPA

control_span.quote: Before any account is activated, the customer's name shall be screened against the UNSC sanctions lists and the lists of individuals and entities designated under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967

rationale: Control KYC-C04 requires V-CIP sessions to be conducted by trained officials, recorded end-to-end, geo-tagged, and subjected to a liveness check before account activation.

obligation_span.quote: Video-based Customer Identification Process (V-CIP) shall be conducted only by a trained official of the RE, with end-to-end recording, geo-tagging of the customer and a liveness check

control_span.quote: Video-based Customer Identification Process (V-CIP) sessions shall be conducted only by trained officials of the Bank, recorded end-to-end, geo-tagged and subjected to a liveness check before the account is activated

rationale: Control KYC-C08 directly satisfies the obligation by requiring every customer to be assigned a risk category of Low, Medium or High at onboarding.

obligation_span.quote: Every RE shall carry out risk categorisation of customers as low, medium or high risk

control_span.quote: Every customer shall be assigned a risk category of Low, Medium or High at onboarding based on customer profile, geography, product and channel

rationale: Control KYC-C10 requires periodic KYC updation for medium risk customers, but specifies a period of ten years which is longer than the regulatory requirement of eight years.

obligation_span.quote: at least once in every eight years for medium risk customers

control_span.quote: Periodic updation of KYC shall be carried out at least once every ten years for Medium risk customers

missing_elements: Parameter mismatch: regulation 2920 days vs control 3650 days
Updation period is 10 years instead of 8 years

rationale: Control KYC-C11 matches the requirement to perform periodic KYC updation at least once every ten years for low risk customers.

obligation_span.quote: at least once in every ten years for low risk customers

control_span.quote: Periodic updation of KYC shall be carried out at least once every ten years for Low risk customers

rationale: Control KYC-C12 fully covers the requirement to report suspicious transactions to FIU-IND within seven working days of determination.

obligation_span.quote: Every RE shall report suspicious transactions to FIU-IND within seven working days of arriving at a conclusion that a transaction is suspicious

control_span.quote: a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) shall be furnished to FIU-IND within seven working days of such determination

rationale: Control KYC-C13 matches the obligation to furnish cash transaction reports to FIU-IND for every month by the 15th day of the succeeding month.

obligation_span.quote: Every RE shall furnish cash transaction reports to FIU-IND for every month by the 15th day of the succeeding month

control_span.quote: Cash Transaction Reports (CTR) shall be furnished to FIU-IND for every month by the 15th day of the succeeding month

rationale: Control KYC-C14 perfectly mirrors the obligation to preserve transaction and customer identification records for at least five years after account closure or relationship end.

obligation_span.quote: Every RE shall preserve records of transactions and of identification of customers for at least five years after the business relationship has ended or the account has been closed, whichever is later

control_span.quote: Records of all transactions and of customer identification, including KYC documents and account files, shall be preserved for at least five years after the business relationship has ended or the account has been closed, whichever is later
